text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it...
I hear this area is 'haunted' at night..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Let's leave before
we provoke them too much...

I tried to hurry away from the scene.
—Right then.
Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...! That voice is...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, everyone! Thank you all
for gathering tonight for my sake!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let us begin!
An opera of the Overlord, by the Overlord, and for the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...!
Around Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, something not very pleasant...
In any case, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well...? If it isn't Cafe!
Could it be that you've come to watch my opera practice?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not quite it...
...How should I put it?

"If I tell the truth, it might scare T.M. Opera O.
What should I do...?"
choice_data_list: Let's keep it under wraps so we don't scare anyone.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, there are a lot of "somethings"
surrounding you right now...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Those are like invisible thoughts and feelings—
and not very good ones at that...
We should hurry and leave this place..."

Even the ever-optimistic T.M. Opera O
looked surprised. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Magnificent!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A multitude of spectators have gathered,
drawn in by my sheer charm!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall sing! For all of you who,
though unseen, are present right here!
Now, you too shall sing praises to this "Supreme King"!
("Overlord"...!! "Overlord"...!!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This is...!?
"They" are... rejoicing...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I welcome any and all spectators—
for such is the Overlord! Whether they possess physical form or not is a trivial matter!

(Praise the "Overlord"—!!
"Overlord"...!! "Overlord"...!!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The voices keep growing louder...!
Surging forward like a mighty river—

("Overlord"...!! "Overlord"...!!
"Overlord"...!! "Overlord"...!!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "'Overlord'... 'Overlord'..."—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, have you been captivated by me as well, Cafe!? How wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can't resist their enthusiasm...!
I want to scream at the top of my lungs too—!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Ah...!
'Long live the "Conqueror"'...!
'Long live the "Conqueror"'...！"

"It must have been an incredible surge of passion;
Manhattan Cafe continued chanting 'Conqueror' for quite some time until she left the scene..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-san, curfew is soon.
Would you like to head back with us?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops... is it that time already?
Very well, let us head back together!

And so, the three of us, including T.M. Opera O,
ended up heading home together, but—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"This is bad...
They're following us..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... And what's more,
it was toward Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If Opera O were to look back now,
"they" would likely remain forever—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Cafe-san, regarding that song from earlier,
I'd really love to hear your thoughts on it—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't...
I must not look... over here...!
(Urrgghhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: *pant*... Somehow... made it...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Cafe-san?
Are you saying there's something over there!?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... please just keep your eyes
fixed on what's ahead...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! I am not quite sure of the reason,
but seeing Cafe-san strike such magnificent poses was thoroughly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway,
I'm just glad you're safe..."

Though completely worn out, Manhattan Cafe
somehow managed to protect T.M. Opera O to the very end...!
